build_phyre_package: build the phyre package by running python setup.py install to compile simulator bindings and install dependencies
run_build_ext_commands: run the custom build_ext command that executes make react_deps and make develop before building C++ extensions
install_phyre_dependencies: install the phyre package dependencies including numpy, scipy, tornado, thrift, imageio, joblib, and nose
review_readme_link_rewriting: review the regex substitutions that rewrite relative README links to absolute GitHub URLs for markdown and image files
configure_package_data: configure the phyre package data to include interface Python files, simulator bindings, data files, and visualization static files
